name: LiveMedBench
description: LiveMedBench is a continuously updated, contamination-free medical benchmark designed to evaluate large language models in clinical settings. It features real-world clinical cases harvested weekly, strict temporal separation from training data, and an automated rubric-based evaluation framework aligned with expert physician criteria.
reputation: A very recent medical benchmark focused on contamination-free, continuously updated evaluation; adoption is still emerging and it is not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Contains 2,756 real-world cases across 38 specialties with 16,702 unique evaluation criteria; addresses data contamination and temporal misalignment; evaluation aligns strongly with expert physicians.
